title: Analyst cost-history rows are orphaned: P3 'rides along on the analyst's normal commit+push' but the analyst is a non-pushing (decider-mediated) agent
recommendation: Give the analyst's PROP-101 Phase-1 cost self-report an explicit, unconditional push path for monitor/analyst/cost-history.jsonl, OR route the row through the decider. Do NOT route it through workspace-sync FUSE->git (banned by PROP-065 for git-append-only files).
executive_summary: The analyst (Opus, the single most expensive agent at ~$8-11/run) has written ZERO cost-history rows since 2026-06-18T04:17, despite firing on schedule ~7+ times (scheduler lastRunAt 2026-06-20T04:08). Peer Phase-1 agents curmudgeon (last row 2026-06-20T05:13, 15 rows) and analyst-baby (logs every no-op) are fine. Root cause: analyst.md Step P3 appends the cost row to the CLONE path monitor/analyst/cost-history.jsonl and says it 'rides along on the analyst's normal commit+push' -- but analyst.md line 518 architecturally forbids the analyst from committing/pushing ('Do NOT attempt git clone, git commit, or git push. The decider handles git'). The analyst has 0 pushes in the last 7 days. Because cost-history.jsonl is git-append-only (PROP-065), workspace-sync will NOT rescue it FUSE->git, and P3 writes to the clone (not FUSE) anyway -- so the appended row dies when the analyst's run-local clone is deleted at end of run. The gap is drought-correlated: rows exist for 2026-06-14..06-18 (right after PROP-101 landed), then went silent once the dome entered its day-64 mechanical-AR-only drought with no commit-worthy output.

evidence.analyst_postlude_summary_fresh: monitor/analyst/latest-analysis-summary.txt FUSE mtime 2026-06-20 04:14 -- analyst DOES reach its postlude; P1 (FUSE summary) and P2 (status.json FUSE) survive via workspace-sync; only P3 (clone cost-history) is lost
evidence.analyst_md_line_518: Do NOT attempt git clone, git commit, or git push. Write outputs to workspace. The decider handles git.
evidence.analyst_md_step_P3: Append one JSON line to the CLONE monitor/analyst/cost-history.jsonl ... The clone-side write rides along on the analyst's normal commit+push. (contradicts line 518: there is no normal analyst push)
evidence.write_self_cost_sh_header: writes the result to the clone-side path so the agent's normal commit+push carries it to origin. Never writes to FUSE.
evidence.git_append_only_membership: monitor/analyst/cost-history.jsonl is in workspace-sync.md GIT_APPEND_ONLY (PROP-065) -- FUSE->git rescue is intentionally denied

root_cause: PROP-101 Phase 1 reused the curmudgeon/baby cost-report pattern (clone-append + rides-along-on-push) for the analyst without accounting for the analyst's different git model. Curmudgeon and analyst-baby push every run, so their rides-along works. The analyst is decider-mediated and pushes nothing in steady state, so its rides-along has no carrier.
unverified_point: The exact mechanism by which the 6 existing rows (2026-06-14..06-18) reached git could not be confirmed from a depth-50 shallow clone (the only commit touching the file within depth is the grafted shallow-boundary commit). Hypothesis: the analyst had commit-worthy verdict/FAIL-integration work in that window that triggered a push the cost row rode along on; once the drought removed all commit-worthy output, the carrier disappeared. Does not affect the current-state diagnosis (rows silent for 2 days across 7+ runs).

recommended_fix_options.change: In analyst.md Step P3, after the write-self-cost.sh append, add an explicit targeted commit+push of ONLY monitor/analyst/cost-history.jsonl from the analyst's clone, guarded by the PAT-prelude DOME_PAT and a git pull --rebase. cost-history.jsonl is git-append-only and single-writer-per-agent, so a targeted push is low-collision. Grants the analyst a narrowly-scoped push capability (one git-append-only file) -- an architecture change from line 518's blanket no-push, which is why this is operator-gated. Must update analyst.md line 518 to carve out the cost-history exception so the two statements stop contradicting.
recommended_fix_options.risk: Analyst gains a push surface. Mitigated by scoping to one append-only file + git pull --rebase before push.

recommended_fix_options.change: Analyst writes the cost row to a FUSE handoff file (e.g. monitor/analyst/pending-cost-row.json); the decider, on its next run, appends it to cost-history.jsonl from the decider's clone and pushes. Keeps the analyst push-free but adds a handoff hop and up-to-4h latency, and needs decider.md changes.
recommended_fix_options.risk: Latency + a new handoff to maintain; more moving parts than A.

recommended_fix_options.change: Accept that analyst no-op/drought runs are uninstrumented; rely on the 6 representative rows for the analyst cost model.
recommended_fix_options.risk: Silently violates the PROP-101 'every run, including no-op' invariant on the priciest agent; corrupts cross-agent cost comparison; hides any future analyst cost spike. Not recommended but cheap.

verification_pattern: node -e "const fs=require('fs');try{const t=fs.readFileSync('monitor/analyst/cost-history.jsonl','utf8').trim();const rows=t?t.split('\n').filter(Boolean).map(l=>JSON.parse(l)):[];if(!rows.length)process.exit(1);const last=rows[rows.length-1];const ageDays=(Date.now()-Date.parse(last.run_at))/86400000;process.exit(ageDays<2?0:1)}catch(e){process.exit(1)}" && echo FIXED || echo STILL_BROKEN
verification_pattern_explanation: Behavioral check: passes only when the most recent analyst cost-history row is <2 days old. Analyst fires 3x/day, so post-fix the row is always fresh (FIXED); pre-fix it is stuck at 2026-06-18 (STILL_BROKEN). Runs cwd=clone, matching prop-auto-close.js --workspace invocation.
other_side_considerations: Marginal info from logging each near-identical drought no-op run is low -- we already know analyst Opus runs cost ~$8-11 from the 6 existing rows, so ~$25-33/day during a 3x/day drought is estimable without the rows.
The drought is the abnormal regime; once the dome author resumes activity the analyst will produce commit-worthy work and the rides-along carrier returns on its own, partially self-healing the gap.

Counter to the above: tinker's Mode 3 cost time-series is the consumer, and a growing hole on the priciest agent during a multi-week drought is precisely when an operator would want to confirm whether the analyst is burning Opus dollars on no-op fresh-eyes passes. That answer currently isn't in the data.

Granting the analyst any push surface (Option A) widens its blast radius and partially erodes the clean 'decider owns git' invariant several safety properties lean on. Option B preserves the invariant at the cost of latency.
cross_references: PROP-101 (real cost measurement, Phase 1 -- source of Step P3)
PROP-065 (git-append-only deny -- why FUSE->git rescue is NOT an option here)
PROP-107 (prune-integrity reports success but doesn't push -- same class: agent does work, push step doesn't carry it)
analyst.md line 518 (no-push invariant) vs analyst.md Step P3 (rides-along claim)
curmudgeon.md Step 9 / analyst-baby.md Step 10 (the always-push peers whose rides-along works)
completion_criteria: analyst cost-history.jsonl receives a fresh row on a no-op/no-commit analyst run; verification_pattern returns FIXED; analyst.md P3 and line 518 no longer contradict each other.
